name: zalo-messaging-mcp
description: Zalo (messaging): me, list_inbound, get_thread, send, reply. Every tool maps to a documented endpoin

platform_mcp_zalo_app_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALO_APP_ID
platform_mcp_zalo_app_id.description: ID of your Zalo app (developers.zalo.me > app > Thông tin ứng dụng).

platform_mcp_zalo_secret_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALO_SECRET_KEY
platform_mcp_zalo_secret_key.description: The app's secret key (Khóa bí mật của ứng dụng); sent only as the secret_key header of the token request.

platform_mcp_zalo_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALO_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_zalo_refresh_token.description: OA refresh_token from the OA authorisation (POST https://oauth.zaloapp.com/v4/oa/access_token with grant_type=authorization_code). Valid 3 months and single-use: each refresh returns a new one that replaces it (persisted when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set). Access tokens last 25 h.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v2.0/oa/getoa: the OA's id, name, description, is_verified, num_follower, package.

tools.name: list_inbound
tools.description: GET /v2.0/oa/listrecentchat: the latest message of each recent conversation (max 10 per page; offset 0 = most recent). src 1 = from the user, 0 = from the OA; `from`/`to` are user or OA ids and a user's id is the thread_id for get_thread/reply; sent_at is epoch ms. Needs the 'Quyền quản lý tin nhắn người dùng' permission.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: GET /v2.0/oa/conversation: messages between the OA and one user (thread_id = the user's user_id), newest first, max 10 per page.

tools.name: send
tools.description: POST /v3.0/oa/message/cs: a consultation (Tin Tư vấn) text message, ≤2000 characters, to a user_id who follows or has interacted with the OA; free within 48 h of the user's last interaction, otherwise it consumes the OA's quota. `subject` is ignored.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Replies in a conversation by sending a consultation text message to the thread's user (thread_id = user_id).
